products.name: BuildStrong OPC 53 Grade Cement
products.shortDescription: High-strength OPC cement for RCC and structural work.

products.name: FiberGrip Claw Hammer 16oz

products.name: Precision Spirit Level 24 inch

products.name: TorqueMax Impact Drill 13mm

products.name: CutPro Angle Grinder 4 inch

products.name: HydroFlow PVC Pipe 1 inch

products.name: Brass Angle Valve Premium

products.description: Quarter-turn brass angle valve with chrome finish for smooth control and long life.

products.name: SecureSite ABS Safety Helmet
products.shortDescription: Lightweight industrial helmet with adjustable harness.
products.description: ISI-style construction helmet engineered for impact protection and all-day comfort.

products.name: CutShield Safety Gloves
products.shortDescription: Cut-resistant gloves for fabrication and handling jobs.
products.description: Breathable and high-grip gloves for improved protection while handling sharp edges and materials.
